messages:
Maya: Quick heads up — the new mini Next sample (llamachain integration) fails during local dev with recurring 401s.
Maya: Steps: git clone, cp .env.example .env.local (API_KEY=ephemeral...), npm run dev → pages/_app.tsx errors out when fetching model list.
Sam: Hmm, are you using the JS alpha SDK or the stable one? We recently renamed env var from REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_INFERENCE_KEY in the alpha.
Maya: Using the version from the starter's package.json (0.3.1). I expected parity with docs. Noticed package.json has "@redwood/inference": "0.3.1-alpha" though.
Oliver: That's probably it — alpha expects REDWOOD_INFERENCE_KEY and also changed retry behavior default. If you set both vars it should work.
Maya: Adding the new var fixed the 401s but now SSR requests to /api/generate are hitting retry loops and doubling latency.
Julie: Can you paste console log from the server side? Might be the SDK auto-retry + our edge adapter causing idempotent retry of POST.
Maya: Server log snippet:
```
[dev] POST /api/generate 500 (retrying)
Error: request failed with status 502
  at fetch (/app/node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/index.js:45:12)
```
Oliver: We shipped a change to the edge adapter that doesn't attach idempotency keys for server-side streaming calls. That plus SDK's 2 retries = double submits.
Sam: Short-term: set INFERENCE_RETRY_COUNT=0 in .env.local or downgrade SDK to 0.3.0. Long-term: I can add idempotency header when edge adapter detects server-side context.
Maya: Created a tiny repro branch + screenshot: github.com/redwood-inference/mini-next-sample/tree/ux-auth-retry. Also added a README note about env var mismatch.
devex-bot: Reminder — please add an integration test in /tests/e2e/startup that runs npm install && npm run dev for the starter to catch this.
Julie: Assigning to @sam for the edge adapter fix and to @maya for README patch. Sam — can you estimate? ETA 2 days?
Sam: Yep — I'll open PR for adapter within 48h and add a test. Will also flag SDK parity doc so docs + starter align.
